the two different mutants of AsaP(1) were successfully crystallized.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been able to produce crystals of AsaP_E294A and E294Q mutants of the toxic endopeptidases from A. salmonicida subp. achromogenese, which diffracted X-ray beyond 2.5 A resolution.
the AsaP1 mutants were successfully crystallized and diffracted X-ray radiation to 2.0A.
the two mutants AsaP1 E294A and AspP1_E294 Q were successfully crystallized in two different crystal forms, and that diffraction data to 2.0A resolution were obtained for these crystals.
The main takeaway from our work is that
AsaP1 mutants are amenable to crystallization and can be used to study the structure of the active-site residues in the presence of different inhibitors.
it was possible to crystallize the two mutants of AsaP, and that the mutants crystallized under different conditions, suggesting that they have different packing in the crystals.
AsaP1 is a good candidate for structural studies and can be expressed and crystallized in several different space groups.
